briefdescription.para: Placeholder aring used as a default / fallback for code paths that need an ARing-shaped object but no real arithmetic.

detaileddescription.para: Element type is long and every operation is a no-op or trivial. mOriginalRing carries the actual PolynomialRing the dummy is standing in for so callers can still locate the "real" ring for fall-through queries. Appears as a variant alternative in VectorArithmetic's std::variant so templated code that does not understand a given ring still has a valid instantiation.
